verdict.missed: Not distinguishable at 711 hotels (95% CIs overlap).
verdict.merges: Not distinguishable at 711 hotels (95% CIs overlap).
verdict.coverage: Not distinguishable at 711 hotels (95% CIs overlap).
verdict.missell: The Plexe mapper better than Plexe production alone (95% CIs do not overlap)
verdict.f05: The Plexe mapper better than Plexe production alone (95% CIs do not overlap)

human.frame: blind review of 60 groupings the safety layer split, drawn from 653 held-out hotels of our internal 2,045-hotel evaluation set (aggregate only), plus 10 control pairs both systems kept together

help.missed: Share of same-room gold pairs placed in different rows.
help.merges: Share of different-room gold pairs placed in the same row.
help.coverage: Share of the frame's supplier names the system placed. Names it did not return count as unplaced single rows.
help.missell: Share of rows (with 2+ priced names the gold places) whose cheapest displayed price comes from a name in a different gold room than the row's majority.
help.f05: B-cubed F0.5 over names the gold places, averaged per hotel. It weights precision (no wrong merges) above recall (no missed matches).

f05_note: F0.5 counts wrong merges more than missed matches, because wrong merges cause mis-sells.
frame: 711 public v5.1 hotels; gold from the hotels' own websites. v5.1 gold only checks names worded the same as the hotel's list, so missed-match numbers are a floor.
